defects.D1: The Claude Code image cannot connect to its workspace on an SRW agent pod. The pod spec is SRW's (agent_provisioner.py securityContext runAsUser/runAsGroup 999, readOnlyRootFilesystem), the image's account is uid 10001, and the harness scrubs os.environ to PATH at start (harnesses/claude-code/srw_claude_code_harness/__main__.py scrub_process_environment(keep=['PATH'])), so asyncssh's getpass.getuser() falls back to pwd.getpwuid(999) and fails. Reproduced locally: podman run --passwd=false --user 999:999 ... getpass.getuser() with the environment cleared -> KeyError 'getpwuid(): uid not found: 999'; --user 10001:10001 -> 'harness'. The image smoke test checks getuser() under uid 10001 only.
defects.D2: SRW's Anthropic transport (_create_anthropic_llm in shared/runtime/core/loader.py) always sends temperature (and top_p/top_k when set) for a model without a Claude thinking profile; Meta's Anthropic-compatible API rejects temperature (400). No Expert or catalog setting omits it: null sampling values are dropped by config resolution.
defects.D3: The Claude Code harness reports goal_achieved true with freeze_data.status job_completed; completion.py maps a job_complete with goal_achieved (no verification) to completed, so a successful custom-harness job never reaches pending_review and the Cockpit Review page shows 'This job is not awaiting review.' SRW's own harness reports the same kind of job into pending_review. Its deliverables are also absolute paths (/home/agent-host/workspace/hello.txt) where SRW's are workspace-relative.
defects.D4 (minor): A custom pod whose job is refused before start (protocol mismatch) stays registered and ready until its 600 s idle exit (srw-agent-j-9a88507a: refused 23:30:44, deregistered 23:40:42, deleted 23:41:18), counting toward MAX_AGENTS and holding the Secret; it is also eligible for another job of the same image.
